tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background behind marketing pages and the auth screens.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: App-shell background behind the main column; tracks of progress bars.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, modals, inputs. The default ground for data.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Table header row, stepper buttons, quiet wells inside a card.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of clickable table rows and the dropzone resting fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders and section hairlines (decorative; never the only boundary of a control).

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Row separators inside tables and card heads.

tokens.name: line-field
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, checkboxes and the toggle track: 3.6:1 on surface-card light, 3.4:1 dark. The source app used #d6d0c6 (1.5:1), raised here to meet the 3:1 control-border floor.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface-page, surface-card, surface-muted and every *-bg tint.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: form labels, nav items on light grounds, table cells of lesser weight. On surface-card and surface-page.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, hints, column headers, placeholder copy. 5.5:1 on surface-page light, 6.1:1 on surface-muted dark.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on surface-card and surface-page.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Terracotta: the brand hue. Active tab underline, the accent button, chart series 3. White text on it is 4.35:1 in light (source pair, kept): use it only for bold 15px+ labels, or use accent-strong.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Accent as text on surface-card/surface-page (6.1:1 light, 8.5:1 dark) and the accent button's hover fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent or accent-strong fill.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Gold: the gold button, the focus halo, count badges in the sidebar. Text on it is ink (10.5:1).

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gold fill (10.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: Hover highlight of chart bars. Not for text or lone marks on light grounds (2.3:1).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Deep teal: progress bars, the toggle's on state, chart series 1. 7.5:1 on surface-card light.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: WhatsApp button border and live dots. White on it is 6.3:1.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button, selected chips and segmented options, toasts. Flips to near-white in dark.

tokens.name: inverse-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on inverse and inverse-hover (15:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: App sidebar and the mobile top bar.

tokens.name: sidebar-hover
tokens.usage: Sidebar item hover and the account block.

tokens.name: sidebar-active
tokens.usage: The current sidebar item.

tokens.name: sidebar-ink
tokens.usage: Sidebar headings and the active item label.

tokens.name: sidebar-muted
tokens.usage: Resting sidebar item labels (9.3:1 light, 7.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: green-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind green-ink in pills and notices: success, done, active.

tokens.name: green-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on green-bg (always ≥7.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: red-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind red-ink in pills and notices: failure, rejection, destructive confirmation.

tokens.name: red-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on red-bg (always ≥7.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: amber-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind amber-ink in pills and notices: caution, pending, needs review.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on amber-bg (always ≥7.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: blue-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind blue-ink in pills and notices: information, scheduled, in progress.

tokens.name: blue-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on blue-bg (always ≥7.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: gray-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind gray-ink in pills and notices: neutral, archived, not applicable.

tokens.name: gray-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on gray-bg (always ≥7.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: exp-expired
tokens.usage: Expired (منتهي): date is today or past. Solid fill for matrix segments, dots and chart slices; ≥3:1 on surface-card in both themes. Always paired with its word and icon.

tokens.name: exp-expired-bg
tokens.usage: Expired (منتهي): date is today or past. Tint behind exp-expired-ink in the expiry badge.

tokens.name: exp-expired-ink
tokens.usage: Expired (منتهي): date is today or past. Text on exp-expired-bg.

tokens.name: exp-d30
tokens.usage: Critical (≤30 days). Solid fill for matrix segments, dots and chart slices; ≥3:1 on surface-card in both themes. Always paired with its word and icon.

tokens.name: exp-d30-bg
tokens.usage: Critical (≤30 days). Tint behind exp-d30-ink in the expiry badge.

tokens.name: exp-d30-ink
tokens.usage: Critical (≤30 days). Text on exp-d30-bg.

tokens.name: exp-d60
tokens.usage: Warning (31–60 days). Solid fill for matrix segments, dots and chart slices; ≥3:1 on surface-card in both themes. Always paired with its word and icon.

tokens.name: exp-d60-bg
tokens.usage: Warning (31–60 days). Tint behind exp-d60-ink in the expiry badge.

tokens.name: exp-d60-ink
tokens.usage: Warning (31–60 days). Text on exp-d60-bg.

tokens.name: exp-d90
tokens.usage: Notice (61–90 days). Solid fill for matrix segments, dots and chart slices; ≥3:1 on surface-card in both themes. Always paired with its word and icon.

tokens.name: exp-d90-bg
tokens.usage: Notice (61–90 days). Tint behind exp-d90-ink in the expiry badge.

tokens.name: exp-d90-ink
tokens.usage: Notice (61–90 days). Text on exp-d90-bg.

tokens.name: exp-valid
tokens.usage: Valid (more than 90 days). Solid fill for matrix segments, dots and chart slices; ≥3:1 on surface-card in both themes. Always paired with its word and icon.

tokens.name: exp-valid-bg
tokens.usage: Valid (more than 90 days). Tint behind exp-valid-ink in the expiry badge.

tokens.name: exp-valid-ink
tokens.usage: Valid (more than 90 days). Text on exp-valid-bg.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1 (teal). Order series 1→7; past seven, group the rest as 'other' in chart-7. ≥3:1 on surface-card.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Categorical series 2 (ochre). Order series 1→7; past seven, group the rest as 'other' in chart-7. ≥3:1 on surface-card.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Categorical series 3 (terracotta). Order series 1→7; past seven, group the rest as 'other' in chart-7. ≥3:1 on surface-card.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Categorical series 4 (blue). Order series 1→7; past seven, group the rest as 'other' in chart-7. ≥3:1 on surface-card.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Categorical series 5 (plum). Order series 1→7; past seven, group the rest as 'other' in chart-7. ≥3:1 on surface-card.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Categorical series 6 (olive). Order series 1→7; past seven, group the rest as 'other' in chart-7. ≥3:1 on surface-card.

tokens.name: chart-7
tokens.usage: Categorical series 7 (slate). Order series 1→7; past seven, group the rest as 'other' in chart-7. ≥3:1 on surface-card.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px outline at 2px offset. 17:1 on surface-card light, 10:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus-halo
tokens.usage: The 4px gold glow around a focused input, beside its line-field→ink border change (decorative; the border carries the 3:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and the mobile sidebar.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: page-title

styles.name: section-title

styles.name: body-strong

styles.name: data

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Bot commands, webhook URLs, env keys. Always LTR.

tokens.usage: Marketing section rhythm.

tokens.usage: Progress and matrix bars, chart bar tops.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, small badges, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small buttons, sidebar items, icon buttons, segmented inner options.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, toasts, the segmented track.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Notices and dropzone rows.

tokens.name: radius-2xl

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Modals and marketing panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill

tokens.usage: Floating search bars, toasts, popovers. Cards at rest have no shadow: borders, not shadows.

tokens.usage: Hover lift of clickable cards.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and the notification panel.
